Homebrew Reference Book: Clone Wars Saga Edition Fan Sourcebook - Bounty Hunters & Mercenaries (Part 1)

A group of small-time bounty hunters and mercenaries, the Thunder Road Crew are a tight-knit group bound together through circumstance and through the leadership of "Boss."

  • Boss: Leader of a band of mercenaries hired by the Separatists to patrol Death Canyon, Boss runs a crew of a few dozen. When, six months before the end of the Clone Wars, Boss' crew cornered Jedi heroes Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, he thought victory was assured. Unfortunately for Boss, the Jedi commandeered a speeder and escaped his clutches.
  • Grunk: A Gamorrean mercenary, Grunk participates in the chase against the Jedi. He boards their speeder, and briefly overpowered Jedi Master Kenobi. Grunk's good fortune turns when Kenobi thrusts him into a rocky overhang, knocking him off.
  • Mooney: A Human mercenary, and one of Boss' most trusted lieutenants, Mooney is known for his biting wit, which is lost on most of his dim-witted allies. Present at the chase, Mooney is little more than a spectator.
